# Firmware Notice

The firmware byte arrays in this pack are mechanical conversions of firmware files supplied by the user for Si468x development. This project does not assert a new license or redistribution right for those firmware images.

Keep and follow any Silicon Labs / Skyworks / HD Radio / other vendor license terms that apply to the original firmware release and to the target product. HD Radio functionality may also be subject to separate licensing requirements.

The universal `Si468x.h` driver is technically independent of these image files and can be used with a different authorized firmware source.
